categoryName: Small appliances — iron, kettle, immersion rod, mixer, induction, room heater, blower, fan, geyser, hair dryer, emergency light

skuLines.line: Immersion water heater rod — 1000W, budget ISI
skuLines.examples: Usha IH 2410 1000W; Singer IR07 1000W; Halonix IM1000; local ISI copper-coated rod
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Mar peak; second bump in the Jul-Sep monsoon when nothing dries
skuLines.notes: The single highest-turn appliance in a cold hill township — cheap, fails often (1-2 winters), bought again. Open-coil rods are a fire/shock risk in hostels: stock the shockproof, ISI, 2-yr-replacement versions and demo earthing at the counter. IS 302 (Part 2 Sec 201) / QCO 2026 makes ISI compulsory — do not buy uncertified stock.

skuLines.line: Immersion water heater rod — 1500W, branded shockproof
skuLines.examples: Halonix Nova Signet 1500W (₹523 on BigBasket); Bajaj Immersion Rod 1500W; Baltra BIH-205 Crest 1500W; Singer IR 10 NXT 1500W
skuLines.seasonality: Nov-Feb sharp peak; useful year-round in Rajgarh
skuLines.notes: Heats a bucket in ~8-10 min vs a geyser nobody has in a hostel room. Wholesale is ₹275-565 (Shopzop) against ₹500-900 retail — the fattest margin in the whole appliance shelf. Carry 2-yr replacement-warranty brands: no service centre within 30-50 km.

skuLines.line: Bucket / immersion heater with thermostat + auto cut-off (safety SKU)
skuLines.examples: Usha IH 3810; Baltra Rapid with thermostat; Havells water heater rod with auto cut-off
skuLines.notes: The version to push where there are small children and babies — a forgotten open rod boils dry and burns. Worth a warden-approved SKU the school can permit where plain rods are banned.

skuLines.line: Electric kettle — 1.5L stainless steel, mass value
skuLines.examples: Pigeon Amaze Plus 1.5L; Butterfly EKN 1.5L; Baltra Fast 1.5L; Prestige PKOSS 1.5L
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes at session start (Apr and Jul intake) and Nov-Jan
skuLines.notes: The default first appliance a hosteller or a new staff family buys. Also the night-feed water source for families with babies. Keep depth — this line alone can be 2-3 facings.

skuLines.line: Electric kettle — 1.5-1.8L branded, concealed element, auto cut-off
skuLines.examples: Bajaj KTX 15; Havells Aqua Plus 1.5L; Prestige PKOSS 1.8L; Philips HD9318
skuLines.notes: Concealed element survives the hard hill water far better than an exposed coil; still descale-and-clean advice at sale. Replacement cycle 3-4 years.

skuLines.examples: Pigeon Favourite 0.5L; Butterfly EKN 0.5L; Baltra Cute 0.8L
skuLines.notes: Low wattage is the point — it passes hostel load limits that ban 1500W devices, and it fits a study table. Cheapest legitimate way a student gets hot water.

skuLines.line: Multi-purpose cooking kettle (noodle/soup kettle, steel bowl)
skuLines.examples: Pigeon Kessel Multipurpose 1.2L; Bajaj Majesty Multifunction; Baltra Multi Cook
skuLines.notes: Where hostels forbid induction and hot plates, this is what students actually cook maggi, eggs and soup in. Fast-moving, high-margin, and it keeps a whole wallet on campus.

skuLines.examples: Borosil Vision 1.5L glass kettle; Agaro Regal; Balzano Elegante
skuLines.notes: Glass breaks on 30-50 km of hill road — insist on the supplier bearing transit breakage, and keep 1-2 pcs only. Thin, gifting-led demand from senior staff and university faculty.

skuLines.line: Commercial tea / water urn — 10-20L electric boiler
skuLines.examples: Bajaj commercial tea urn 10L; Baltra Water Boiler 10L; Sunflame / Sunmix SS urn 15L
skuLines.cohort: staff (institutional — the two canteens, hostel messes)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; replacement before winter and before session start
skuLines.notes: Institutional line, bought against a Trust purchase order rather than at the POS counter — but the store should be the supplier, not a Chandigarh dealer. Stock the element and tap as spares.

skuLines.line: Electric milk boiler / milk cooker with auto cut-off
skuLines.examples: Bajaj Majesty MB; Butterfly Wave milk boiler; Prestige PMB 1.5L
skuLines.notes: Married staff quarters with babies — boiled milk twice a day, and nobody wants to watch a pan. Low volume, steady.

skuLines.examples: Pigeon Egg Boiler (3/7 egg); Bajaj MEB; Baltra Boil
skuLines.notes: Hostel-legal (low wattage, auto shut-off). Sells to protein-conscious university students; note many residents here are vegetarian, so keep depth low.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj DX 2 600W (₹1,030); Bajaj DX 5 600W; Usha EI 1602
skuLines.notes: The price-point iron for a student who irons a uniform. Underpowered for heavy cotton and for a dastar, so keep it as the opening price only.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj DX 6 1000W (₹1,540); Bajaj Popular 1000W (₹1,110); Bajaj Majesty DX 11 (₹1,210); Usha Heavy Weight 1000W
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; peaks at session start and Oct-Feb (woollens, layered uniforms)
skuLines.notes: Core line, not optional. School uniforms, university dress code and — specific to this campus — pressing a dastar/turban cloth and starched cotton, which is exactly what a dry iron does better than steam. Keep replacement cords and sole-plate cleaner alongside.

skuLines.examples: Philips GC1905/21 (₹1,438); Bajaj MX 4 Neo 1250W (₹2,500); Bajaj MX 16 1400W; Havells Insta
skuLines.notes: For mixed wardrobes (polyester, suit-salwar, linen). Warn on hard hill water: sell distilled water or an anti-scale variant or the tank blocks in a season. Buying-guide bands: budget steam ₹1,000-1,500, mid ₹1,500-2,500.

skuLines.line: Steam iron — 2000W+ premium, vertical steam / steam burst
skuLines.examples: Bajaj MX 45 2000W (₹4,180); Bajaj MX 40C 2000W (₹4,360); Philips GC2145 Azur
skuLines.notes: One or two facings; senior staff and faculty households only. Slow-moving — a good candidate for the indent/order-book route rather than shelf stock.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj Steam Majesty handheld 1000W (₹6,000); Agaro handheld steamer; Philips STH1000
skuLines.notes: Genuinely useful in a 30+ day monsoon for freshening damp woollens and heavy suits without a board — but a new habit here. Test with 2 pcs before committing.

skuLines.line: Ironing board + iron accessories (sole cleaner, cover, cord)
skuLines.examples: Bathla / Peng Essentials folding board; Nu Steel table-top board; iron sole plate cleaning stick
skuLines.notes: Accessory attach on every iron sold — high margin, low value, no service liability. Table-top boards suit hostel rooms and staff quarters better than full-height.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj GX-1 500W (under ₹2,000); Bajaj Rex 500W; Boss Pride 550W; Butterfly Smart 500W
skuLines.seasonality: Session start, Diwali/Gurpurab gifting, wedding season
skuLines.notes: Fine for light use (chutney, small masala) and it hits the price a new staff family can pay in month one. Hill voltage dips kill cheap motors — pair with a stabilizer pitch.

skuLines.examples: Preethi Blue Leaf 750W; Philips HL7756 750W; Bajaj GX-11 750W; Butterfly Rapid 750W
skuLines.notes: 750W is now the mainstream Indian family SKU (was 500W) — daily masala and batter. Highest-ticket appliance a staff family reliably buys, so its absence is a direct wallet leak to Solan/Nahan. Stock the jars as spares from day one.

skuLines.examples: Sujata Dynamix DX 900W; Butterfly Jet Elite 900W; Preethi Zodiac 750W+; Bajaj Twister 750W JMG
skuLines.notes: Sujata is bought here for motor life, not features — the right pitch where there is no service centre. Also the SKU the fruits-and-veg counter and canteens will want for juice.

skuLines.line: Mixer spares — jars, couplers, blades, gaskets, brushes
skuLines.examples: Preethi / Sujata / Bajaj / Philips OEM jar; nylon coupler; blade assembly; carbon brush pair
skuLines.packSizes: Single jar; coupler pack of 2; blade 1 pc
skuLines.notes: The most under-stocked line in campus retail and the one that decides whether a resident drives 50 km. A ₹60 coupler saves a ₹4,000 mixer. Match couplers to the brands you actually sell — do not buy generic.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj HB 05; Philips HL1655 250W; Inalsa Robot Inox; Boss Portable Blender
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; bump when new babies arrive in staff quarters
skuLines.notes: Baby purée, lassi, soup — and hostel-legal at 250-400W. Genuinely relevant to the married-staff-with-babies cohort that a normal campus store ignores.

skuLines.examples: Pigeon Handy Chopper 400ml; Inalsa Chop Chop; Wonderchef Turbo; Baltra Chop
skuLines.notes: Onion/ginger-garlic prep. Impulse-priced, gifts well, no installation. Keep 2 SKUs, not 5.

skuLines.line: Electric hand mixer / egg beater / dough kneader attachment
skuLines.examples: Inalsa Easy Mix 250W; Agaro hand mixer; Bajaj HM 01
skuLines.seasonality: Bakes cluster around Nov-Jan and festivals
skuLines.notes: Small, real demand where families bake in winter. Pairs with an OTG sale.

skuLines.examples: Prestige Iris Eco 1200W (₹1,349); Prestige Xpress 1200W (₹1,550); Bajaj Majesty Mini 1200W (₹1,850); Prestige PIC 20 1600W (₹1,899)
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; LPG-refill delays and winter
skuLines.notes: On a hill, an LPG cylinder refill can be a week away — an induction plate is the backup stove, not a gadget. Explicitly sold to students/bachelors and small staff kitchens. Check hostel rules: many blocks ban induction in rooms, so the buyer is staff quarters and university flats.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj Magnifique 2000W (₹2,999); Pigeon Cruise 1800W; Cadlec 2000W (₹1,299); iBell 2000W
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; peaks Oct-Feb and at session start
skuLines.notes: The workable everyday-cooking wattage. Power-saver models matter here because campus tariff and load limits bite. Always sell with an induction-base vessel — the commonest return is 'it doesn't heat my old kadai'.

skuLines.examples: Prestige Omega induction-base kadai; Hawkins Futura induction tawa; Pigeon induction base set; Vinod induction pressure cooker
skuLines.notes: Not optional if you sell induction. One vessel per cooktop, minimum. Higher margin than the cooktop itself and no electrical warranty risk.

skuLines.line: Infrared / radiant hot plate cooktop (works with any vessel)
skuLines.examples: Pigeon infrared cooktop 2000W; Usha CJ 1600 hot plate; Baltra Hot Plate single 1500W; Prestige radiant cooktop
skuLines.notes: The answer for households full of aluminium and old steel vessels that induction won't take. Slower and more power-hungry — say so honestly. Wholesalers list it as its own category alongside induction.

skuLines.examples: Prestige PRWO 1.8L; Panasonic SR-WA18; Bajaj RCX 5; Pigeon 1.8L
skuLines.notes: Set-and-forget, hostel-friendly, and doubles as a steamer for the vegetarian kitchen this population runs. Steady, unspectacular.

skuLines.examples: Wonderchef Nutri-Pot; Prestige electric pressure cooker 5L; Kent electric cooker; Instant-style multicooker
skuLines.notes: At 1,500 m altitude, boiling point drops and pressure cooking genuinely matters — a real story to sell on. Still a slow line; order-book it.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj ATX 4 2-slice toaster; Prestige PGMFB sandwich griller; Nova 2-slice; Borosil Krispy grill
skuLines.notes: 3-5 minute breakfast — the reason sandwich makers stay a mainstream entry-price appliance in India. Also a canteen-adjacent item.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj 1603T 16L; Prestige POTG 20L; Agaro Grand 25L; Philips HD6975 25L
skuLines.notes: Bulky, low turns, ~5-8 kg of freight per unit. Keep one 16L on shelf and indent the rest. OTGs and sandwich makers remain the entry-to-mid staples even as air fryers grow.

skuLines.examples: Philips HD9200 4.1L; Havells Prolife Digi; Agaro Regal 4L; Pigeon Healthifry
skuLines.notes: India's fastest-growing small kitchen appliance (₹ market ~USD 217 mn in 2026, ~6.1% CAGR) and multi-function air-fry+bake+rotisserie units are eating the OTG's price band. Aspirational here rather than essential — 1-2 SKUs, demo unit, order-book the rest.

skuLines.line: Fan heater / room blower — 1000-2000W, 2 heat settings
skuLines.examples: Pringle PFH-03 2000W (sold on Blinkit); Bajaj RX11 2000W; Usha FH 3212; Orpat OEH-1220
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Mar; hard peak Nov-Jan; sells out in the first cold week
skuLines.notes: The volume heater in a cold hill town: cheapest, instant, portable. Buy the season's stock by September — one October truck, because a January reorder arrives after the demand. Dries out air and trips overloaded hostel wiring; brief buyers on clearance from curtains and beds.

skuLines.examples: Orient Electric Quartz 800W (₹1,129 on Blinkit); RR Signature Ecoheat Quartz 800W; Bajaj Deluxe 2000W halogen; Usha 3002
skuLines.notes: Directional radiant heat for one person at a desk — exactly the hostel/study use case, and at 800W it fits a room's load. Halogen types are pitched as the safer option around children. Grille and tip-over switch are the things to check before buying stock.

skuLines.line: PTC ceramic fan heater with thermostat
skuLines.examples: Usha HC 812T; Havells Cista PTC; Orpat PTC heater; Havells Cozio
skuLines.notes: The SKU to recommend for a room with a baby or an elderly resident: no glowing element, thermostat cycling, less oxygen burn. PTC and oil-filled are taking share from open-coil and halogen on exactly this safety argument.

skuLines.examples: Orient Electric 9-fin 2400W; Havells Hestio 11-fin; Bajaj Majesty RH 13F; Usha OFR 3809
skuLines.notes: The one heater that can run in a bedroom all night — even heat by convection, holds warmth after switch-off, no burn surface. But 12-18 kg each: freight per unit on hill road is significant and the season is 90 days. Carry 2-3 pcs as demo/immediate and run the rest as a pre-book with a token — staff families will pre-book in September if you ask them.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj Blow Hot 2000W; Sansui carbon heater; Glen convector heater
skuLines.notes: Middle rung between a blower and an OFR. Only worth carrying if the blower and quartz shelves are already full-fed.

skuLines.line: Electric blanket / bed warmer — single and double
skuLines.examples: Expressions double 70W (on Blinkit); Comfort Checkered double (~₹4,000); Warmland single; Tapish double
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Jan; gifting to elderly in Nov
skuLines.notes: Cheap to run (60-120W vs 2000W of heating) and the honest answer for an unheated hill bedroom. Non-electrical failure mode, light to freight, folds flat — a much better winter bet per rupee of shelf than a second OFR.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable electro-thermal hot water bag / hand warmer
skuLines.examples: Warmfinity electric hot water bag (₹250); Balrama 1L 500W chargeable bag; Nea electric bag
skuLines.notes: ₹250 impulse item, mass winter volume, gifts to and from students, replaces the rubber bottle. Failure rate is high and complaints follow — buy only sealed, explosion-proof, marked units and keep the bills for replacement.

skuLines.line: Electric heating pad / orthopaedic heat belt
skuLines.examples: Flamingo orthopaedic heating pad; Dr Trust heating pad; Vissco heat belt
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Mar (joint pain in cold), year-round for chronic use
skuLines.notes: Real demand from elderly residents and from staff with back/knee pain in a cold, hilly, stair-heavy campus. Sits naturally next to the pharmacy/wellness shelf, not the kitchen one.

skuLines.examples: Crompton Juno 3L 3kW (₹4,600); Crompton RapidJet 3L (₹4,800); V-Guard Zio 3L 3000W; Havells Instanio Prime 3L
skuLines.seasonality: Sep-Dec fitting rush before winter; failures cluster Dec-Jan
skuLines.notes: 3kW is now effectively the standard across the whole instant range. This is the appliance a staff family will absolutely not wait for — if the store has no geyser in November, the sale and the goodwill both leave campus. Sell with installation, and stock heating elements + thermostats: hard hill water scales elements every 2-3 years.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj New Shakti 15L; Racold Eterno Pro 15L; AO Smith HSE-VAS-015; Havells Adonia 25L
skuLines.seasonality: Sep-Nov fitting; institutional buying at session breaks
skuLines.notes: The right product for a family bathroom in a Himachal winter, and for hostel/mess blocks bought on Trust POs. Heavy and bulky — hold 1-2 and indent; margin is thin so make it up on installation, the stabilizer and the plumbing kit.

skuLines.line: Geyser & heater spares — element, thermostat, anode rod, capillary
skuLines.examples: 2000W geyser heating element; geyser thermostat; magnesium anode rod; heater tip-over switch
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks Nov-Jan when everything runs at once
skuLines.notes: Hard water plus a 30-50 km trip to the nearest technician means the store that has the element wins the whole repair. Same logic as mixer couplers: tiny inventory, disproportionate loyalty.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj Neo Spectrum 400mm (₹1,700-2,799); Crompton Hiflo Wave Plus 400mm (₹2,348); Usha Maxx Air 400mm; Orpat 300mm
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun only, and mild — Rajgarh summers are short
skuLines.notes: Do not build a plains-sized fan season here. A modest Apr-Jun facing, cleared by July; the monsoon then converts fan demand into air-circulation-for-drying demand, which the same fan serves.

skuLines.examples: Bajaj Neo Spectrum 400mm wall (₹3,150); Crompton Whirlwind Gale 16" (₹2,699); Usha Maxx Air wall 400mm
skuLines.notes: In hostel dorms and canteens a wall fan is the standard fit — floor space is scarce and a table fan gets kicked over. Largely a Trust/institutional line.

skuLines.examples: Crompton High Flo Wave Plus 400mm (₹3,489); Usha Maxx Air pedestal 400mm; Bajaj pedestal 400mm
skuLines.notes: Bulky to freight, short season here. 1-2 pcs plus indent; it also gets hired for functions, which is a service opportunity.

skuLines.examples: Crompton SureBreeze/HS Plus 1200mm; Usha Bloom 1200mm; Atomberg Renesa BLDC 1200mm; Orient Electric Apex
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Jun; institutional refits at session breaks
skuLines.notes: Replacement-driven, not seasonal-impulse. BLDC (28-35W vs 75W) is being pushed by star-rating tightening and pays back fast on a campus paying its own power bill — worth pitching to the Trust for bulk refits. Stock regulators, down-rods and capacitors as spares.

skuLines.examples: Crompton Brisk Air 150mm; Havells Ventil Air DX 200mm; Luminous Vento 250mm; Bajaj Maxima
skuLines.seasonality: Jun-Sep monsoon peak (damp, mould), year-round replacement
skuLines.notes: Under-appreciated must-have for a heavy-monsoon hill campus — damp bathrooms and mess kitchens grow mould and the fans corrode out in 2-3 years. Cheap, small, high-turn, and it earns installation revenue.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable / USB fan (power-cut and hostel fan)
skuLines.examples: Geepas rechargeable fan; iBell RF rechargeable; Sogo rechargeable table fan; USB clip-on desk fan
skuLines.notes: Runs through a power cut, needs no wiring, and is allowed where a mains fan is not. Pairs naturally with the emergency-light shelf; low freight weight.

skuLines.examples: Havells HD3151 1200W; Philips HP8120 / BHD003 1200W; Nova NHP 8100 1200W; Vega VHDH-05
skuLines.seasonality: Jun-Sep monsoon and Nov-Feb winter — i.e. most of the year here
skuLines.notes: Higher real demand here than in a plains town: a Sikh institution means uncut hair (kesh) on both men and women, washed often, in a cold damp climate where it will not air-dry — and a child sent to class with wet hair in December is a health problem. This should be a permanent 2-3 facing line, not a beauty-aisle afterthought.

skuLines.examples: Winston Turbo Pro 1800W; Havells HD3225 2100W; Agaro HD1120 2200W; Vega Pro Touch 1800W
skuLines.notes: For very long or thick hair, a 1200W dryer takes 20+ minutes — the reason the high-wattage line sells to this population specifically. Warn about hostel load limits and cheap extension boards: 2000W through a ₹150 strip is how fires start.

skuLines.line: Hair styler / straightener / dryer-brush (adjacent grooming electrical)
skuLines.examples: Vega VHSH-20 straightener; Philips BHS393; Havells HS4101; Vega hot-air styling brush
skuLines.notes: Borders on the grooming lane. Modest, function-driven demand; keep it thin and be aware some households in a religious institution will not want styling irons at all — read the counter, don't push.

skuLines.examples: Halonix 9W B22 inverter (₹179); Bajaj 12W 8-hr emergency bulb (₹315); Wipro Garnet 12W (₹333); Halonix 20W 4-hr (₹849)
skuLines.notes: This has replaced the boxy emergency lantern as India's default power-cut product: screws into the existing holder, 4-8 hours of backup, ₹150-350 entry. In a hill township on a single feeder it is a genuine staple — sell it in 2s, and keep the ₹179 opening price always in stock.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable LED emergency lantern / tube light
skuLines.examples: Bajaj LED rechargeable emergency light; Wipro emergency lantern; Halonix rechargeable tube; Eveready HL series
skuLines.notes: What a hostel corridor, a mess kitchen and a family kitchen actually need during a long outage — wider throw than a bulb, portable. Institutional bulk potential for hostel blocks. Check that the pack states real backup hours; cheap cells die in one season.

skuLines.examples: Eveready DL63 / Jeevan Sathi rechargeable torch; Rock Light RL rechargeable; Bajaj LED torch; Duracell headlamp
skuLines.cohort: all — students, staff on night duty, families
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter (dark by 5:30 pm Dec-Jan)
skuLines.notes: A closed township on hill paths with early winter darkness and unlit stretches: torches are a safety item for wardens, night staff and any student walking between blocks. Stock a ₹200 opener and a ₹700-1,000 proper one, plus dry cells for the non-rechargeable variants.

skuLines.line: Extension boards, multi-plugs, plug tops, appliance cords, fuses
skuLines.examples: Anchor Penta 4-way board; Havells 6A 4-socket; GM 3+3 board; Anchor 6A/16A plug top; 3-core appliance cord
skuLines.notes: Every appliance sold on this campus needs one, and hostel rooms have 1-2 sockets for 4 devices. Refuse to sell 6A strips for 1500-2000W heaters and rods — stock 16A heavy-duty boards for those and say why. This is the highest-frequency line in the whole appliance lane.

skuLines.examples: V-Guard VG 400; Microtek EM4160; Candes Crystal; Everest stabilizer
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon (storm spikes) and winter (heavy heating load sag)
skuLines.notes: Hill feeders sag and spike; that is what actually kills mixer motors, geyser PCBs and compressors here, and it is what warranty will not cover. Attach it to every geyser and every high-ticket sale — it lowers your own warranty-claim workload.

skuLines.line: Room cooler / air cooler (low priority — carry token depth only)
skuLines.examples: Bajaj personal cooler 20L; Symphony Diet 12T; Crompton Ginie
skuLines.notes: Stated honestly so it does not get over-bought: at 1,500 m with a heavy monsoon, evaporative cooling barely works and the season is ~6 weeks. Zero or one facing. The shelf space belongs to heaters.

trends2026: QCO 2026 / IS 302 (Part 1):2024 — BIS ISI certification becomes mandatory for 90+ household and commercial electrical appliance categories from 1 Oct 2026 (large/medium), 1 Jan 2027 (small), 1 Apr 2027 (micro). This directly covers electric irons, immersion heaters and room heaters. Uncertified regional stock becomes unsellable, so every appliance PO from Sept 2026 onward has to be re-papered against ISI licences.

Air fryers are the fastest-growing small kitchen appliance in India (~USD 217 mn market in 2026, ~6.1% CAGR to 2035), and multi-function air-fry + bake + roast + rotisserie units are cannibalising the entry OTG price band rather than adding to it.

Quick commerce has entered appliances: Blinkit and Zepto now deliver electric kettles, room heaters, immersion rods, geysers and inverter bulbs in 10-20 minutes with published prices. Even where they do not deliver, residents price-check on those apps — a captive store's appliance pricing is now benchmarked against a screenshot.

Rechargeable inverter LED bulbs (₹150-900, 4-8 hour backup, screws into the existing holder) have displaced the boxy emergency lantern as India's default power-cut product; Halonix, Bajaj and Wipro all now run 9W-20W ladders.

750W is the new mainstream family mixer-grinder wattage (was 500W), with 900-1000W heavy-duty models — Sujata Dynamix DX, Butterfly Jet Elite — pushing down into the ₹6,000-8,000 band that used to be premium.

PTC ceramic and oil-filled radiators are taking winter share from open-coil and halogen heaters on a child-safety and 'no oxygen burn' argument, and Indian brands (Havells Hestio, Orient 9-fin, Usha) have widened the fin ladder to hit ₹8,000-16,000.

3000W has standardised across the whole instant-geyser range (nearly every Crompton instant SKU is 3kW), with 4500W 'rapid' 1L variants now appearing — instant geysers are being sold as a second point-of-use unit alongside a storage geyser rather than as a cheap substitute.

Electro-thermal rechargeable hot water bags at ₹200-500 have become a mass winter impulse SKU across e-commerce and q-commerce, largely replacing the rubber hot water bottle; and BLDC ceiling fans (28-35W) are being pushed hard by star-rating tightening, now down to ₹2,500-4,500.
adjacentServices: Indent / order-book desk for big-ticket and bulky items (OFR heaters, storage geysers, pedestal fans, OTGs): resident pays a token, the store consolidates a weekly truck from Nahan / Solan / Chandigarh. Converts slow heavy stock into zero-inventory sales — the single highest-leverage service in this category on a 30-50 km hill road.

Spares-and-repair counter: mixer jars, couplers, blades, carbon brushes, geyser elements and thermostats, iron cords, kettle bases, fan capacitors and regulators, plug tops — plus a retainer tie-up with one campus electrician. A ₹60 coupler keeps a ₹4,000 mixer and a whole household on campus.

Warranty-claim proxy service: the store keeps the bill copy, raises the claim with the brand's service centre 30-50 km away, and hands back a working unit — because a resident cannot make that trip twice. This is the real reason to buy brands with over-the-counter replacement warranty.

Installation and fitting: geyser mounting and plumbing, wall/exhaust fan mounting, stabilizer wiring, ceiling fan replacement. Thin appliance margins (10-20% on geysers and fans) are rebuilt on installation plus the stabilizer and fitting kit.

Seasonal winter rental of room heaters, oil-filled radiators and electric blankets to staff families for Nov-Feb, returned and refurbished each spring. Fits a 90-day season better than outright sale and monetises the same unit for several years.

Institutional supply against Kalgidhar Trust purchase orders: bulk kettles, urns, exhaust and wall fans, hostel-block geysers, emergency lanterns, BLDC ceiling-fan refits. Should be routed through the store rather than a city dealer.

End-of-session buy-back and resale: students and departing staff leave kettles, irons, heaters and induction plates behind every year — a graded second-hand shelf at session start captures the incoming batch at a price they can pay, and stops usable appliances being dumped.

Point-of-sale safety demo and briefing in Punjabi/Hindi: immersion-rod earthing, never leave it in an empty bucket, heater clearance from bedding and curtains, do not run a 2000W heater off a 6A strip. On a campus of 5,000 with children in hostels this reduces both returns and fire risk, and it is a legitimate reason for the store to refuse an unsafe pairing.

Hard-water descaling and element-cleaning service for kettles and geysers, offered once a year before winter — cheap to run, visibly extends appliance life, and creates a reason for a resident to walk in during the off-season.

Extended-warranty / annual appliance service pack sold at the counter on high-ticket items (geyser, OFR, mixer), which is the only realistic after-sales cover available at this distance from a service network.
